Indeed. Most of the world didn’t know where the Strait of Hormuz was until the U.S. and Israel attacked Iran in two wars that led to a global crisis and now the entire world wants the Strait to reopen.


Joe Kent (@joekent16jan19)

Iran would have no incentive to mine the Strait of Hormuz if we weren’t there. 

Pull our forces out & Iran faces major pressure to open the Strait from the rest of the world & loses their justification. 

Staying in our current posture is inviting escalation

LATEST:

I’m hearing from sources on all sides that US–Iran peace deal is near the finish line. There has been real progress and serious movement from both Tehran and Washington. That’s why war hawks are now making a last-minute push to torpedo it.

Pakistan, Qatar, Oman, Turkey, Egypt, Saudi Arabia and others have spent months trying to end a war that devastated the region and threatened global stability.

Across the Middle East, civilians want peace, not more forever wars.

Spoke to Australian TV @abcnews about US-Iran peace talks, last minute change of rhetoric by Trump, and the narrow path to diplomacy to end the war on #Iran.

Video

Spoke to @LBCNews about the possibility of a US-Iran peace deal, contents of the deal and some sticking points, the importance of Israel and Lebanon, and ultimately: Who won this war?

Among falsehoods put out to confuse people about the deadly U.S. attack on an elementary school in Minab is that kids are not at school on Saturdays - weekend in many parts of the world.

I’ve seen serious people believe this lie, not knowing that the Iranian week starts on Saturday and ends on Friday.


Tom Bateman (@tombateman)

I asked Rubio about scrutiny on the decision to launch the Iran war during the daytime when schools were operating, in light of the Congressional questions last week t

Did the economic impacts of the U.S. blockade, crippling sanctions, and threat of escalation force Iran to surrender? No it did not and Washington seems to slowly understand/accept that reality.

Discussed it all on Aljazeera last month in Doha

Video

US-Iran deal is coming…


Ali Hashem علي هاشم (@Alihashem)

According to my sources, the draft proposal that’s supposed to be finalised include: 

-End of war on all fronts including Lebanon

-Freeing several billion dollars of Iran's blocked funds

-Lifting the U.S. naval blockade and opening the strait of Hormuz

-Withdrawal of American forces from the immediate vicinity of Iran

After this, the parties will have 30 days to agree on the nuclear issue.

As female journalists and analysts, we have long been subjected to online harassment, smear campaigns, and physical threats by various political groups. The goal is not debate, but intimidation and silence.

Yet these attacks only strengthen our determination to continue our work with integrity. Solidarity with my friend @farnazfassihi and others facing these reprehensible attacks.


NYTimes Communications (@NYTimesPR)
